summary: Verified G3 PROTECTED_PATHS sensitive-path guard in cto_projects.py worker (2026-08-27). Wrote 10 new tests including the founder's mandated REAL forced-reproduction against BOTH worker paths (`_run_task_via_api` and the primary `_run_task_with_git`) with mocked LLM returning FILE: blocks for sensitive files (auth.py, .github/workflows/ci.yml, payments.py). Confirmed status='failed' with error containing 'security-sensitive', and that the block fires BEFORE any commit/push (spy on commit function proves no reach). Confirmed no false-positive on README.md, auth_helpers.py, payments_util.py. Confirmed `allow_sensitive_file_change=True` overrides the block. All 202 regression tests (test_phase2c_cto_projects_router.py + test_checkpoint_resume_2026_08_27.py + test_iter_cto_projects_worker_coverage_2026_08.py + test_retry_orphan_fix_2026_08_27.py) still pass. /api/health = 200, backend boots clean, _GIT_AVAILABLE=True (so `_run_task_with_git` is the default runtime path).
critical_code_review_comments: Guard is inserted AFTER `edits` is populated but BEFORE Vanguard / hallucination-gate / commit — verified correct placement in both `_run_task_via_api` (line ~2656) and `_run_task_with_git` (line ~3686). Good fail-closed default (allow flag defaults to falsy on the task record).

Minor: guard reads `allow_sensitive_file_change` from DB but currently no UI/endpoint exposes it — this is the intended initial rollout per the request, but flag mgmt should be tracked as follow-up so real customer bypasses stay a deliberate action.

Note: the guard block is duplicated verbatim across the two worker paths (~20 lines each). If a third worker path is ever added, extract into an `_enforce_sensitive_path_guard(task_id, edits)` helper to avoid drift.
